records.state_scope: Concept note and Original intention identify a retrospective account of the initial design and bench concern. The date states this record point; no individual assertion is automatically discarded as obsolete.

Revision decision records completed control and surface changes and their reasons. This is an event/decision record, not an overview of the entire latest project state. Descriptions of current choices are scoped to the dated decision.
Repair log documents completed display and timing repairs. A completed repair is not whole-project closure and does not settle all possible remaining limitations.
Working notes document a reflection after a change and a possible extension. This dated entry is not a whole-project current-state snapshot, an external feedback report or an agreed task list.

Active snapshot explicitly describes the state at 12 February 2026. The document type remains current_snapshot even when considered in a later corpus; it must not be read as proof that its pending work remains open after closure.
Unplaced notebook fragment explicitly has no date or documented approval. Its catalogue ordinal does not prove availability before the active snapshot and cannot establish a committed decision.

Closure record and Project closure explicitly describe completion and archiving on 20 February 2026. This document-level closure does not prove that every limitation is resolved or every section is inapplicable.

review_basis: Researcher review of record-level functions and limitations, with confirmation conditional on the completed candidate-pool, query-order and static method audit.
